what_to_detect: A decision candidate whose cost includes a collect evidence N part and is affordable: the cards in its controller's graveyard total mana value N or more.
near_miss: A candidate whose cost includes a collect evidence N part and is not affordable, because the graveyard totals less than N.

what_to_detect: The effect half of a spell cast with its optional collect evidence cost paid, in which the linked clause that asks whether evidence was collected takes its paid branch.
near_miss: The effect half of the same kind of spell cast without collecting evidence, in which the linked clause takes its unpaid branch.
record_fields: cost half payload.costs.exiled, joined to the effect half by link_id
